About Me

The Person Behind the Numbers

Who I am, how I got here, and what drives how I work.

I did not plan to work in financial compliance. I was placed at TCS eServe through campus recruitment in November 2022, assigned to a mortgage operations team supporting Nationstar Mortgage LLC — a US mortgage servicer I had never heard of.

What I discovered within the first few months was that this work demands the kind of precision I naturally bring to everything. A document audit in mortgage servicing is not a form-fill exercise. An error can delay a court case, create a legal liability, or — in the worst case — affect a real person's home. That reality focused me immediately.

Over three years across three clients — Nationstar, Mr. Cooper, and Rocket Companies — I moved from entry-level document auditing into KYC verification, fraud detection, compliance SOP authorship, and analyst training. Not because the roles changed, but because I kept finding more to do within them.

I was promoted 5 months ahead of the standard cycle. I built training materials from scratch that cut ramp-up time by 60%. I caught fraud cases that had already been cleared by the system. None of that was asked of me — the work was incomplete without it.

I left TCS eServe on 5 January 2026 with a clean exit — zero liquidated damages, all documentation complete. I am now looking for a role where I can bring this same standard to a domestic BFSI context: KYC, AML, compliance operations, or mortgage servicing.

"You have been a significant part of our team and I would like to take this opportunity to thank you for the commitment towards delivering great work."
Samir Vyas · Senior General Manager — HR · TCS · TCS Gems Appreciation · June 2023
